requirements.title: Storage Limitation Principle
requirements.description: Personal data must be kept in a form which permits identification of data subjects for no longer than is necessary for the purposes for which the personal data are processed; baseline permits maximum 10 years for historical telemetry.

requirements.title: Right to Erasure ('Right to be Forgotten')
requirements.description: The data subject shall have the right to obtain from the controller the erasure of personal data without undue delay.

requirements.title: International Data Transfers
requirements.description: Any transfer of personal data to a third country shall take place only if the controller and processor comply with conditions for transfer, including adequacy decisions, appropriate safeguards (SCCs, BCRs), or specific derogations.
